# Booklet maps


```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false

# Add packages: 
#devtools::install_github("SANBI-NBA/nbaR")
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(nbaR)
library(terra)
library(tidyterra)
 
## specify filenames and parameters

map_data_fl <- "^mapdata.gpkg$"

marine_fl <- "^mem_2023_thr_pro.gpkg$"

sa_pei_fl <- "^SA_boundaries_v12.shp$"

cnd_marine_benth_fl <- "^condition.tif$"

cnd_terr_fl <- "^terr_cond.tif$"

eez_fl <- "^eez_MEM2018.gpkg$"

```


```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false

## load data files

marine <- st_read(list.files(path=here::here("data"), 
                             pattern=marine_fl, 
                             recursive = T, 
                             full.names = T)[1]) 


sa_pei <- st_read(list.files(path=here::here("data"), 
                             pattern=sa_pei_fl, 
                             recursive = T, 
                             full.names = T)[1]) 

terr <- st_read(list.files(path=here::here("data"), 
                             pattern=map_data_fl, 
                             recursive = T, 
                             full.names = T)[1], 
                layer = "terr") 
#Estuarine = Non-terrestrial (estuarine habitat)
#freshwater = Non-terrestrial (Aquatic)
#why is there an empty T_Name?


est <- st_read(list.files(path=here::here("data"), 
                             pattern=map_data_fl, 
                             recursive = T, 
                             full.names = T)[1], 
                layer = "est_point") 

freshwater <- st_read(list.files(path=here::here("data"), 
                             pattern=map_data_fl, 
                             recursive = T, 
                             full.names = T)[1], 
                layer = "riv_line") 



cnd_marine_benth <- rast(list.files(path=here::here("data"), 
                             pattern=cnd_marine_benth_fl, 
                             recursive = T, 
                             full.names = T)[1]) 

cnd_terr <- rast(list.files(path=here::here("data"), 
                             pattern=cnd_terr_fl, 
                             recursive = T, 
                             full.names = T)[1]) 

eez <- st_read(list.files(path=here::here("data"), 
                             pattern=eez_fl, 
                             recursive = T, 
                             full.names = T)[1])

```

### data prep

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false
#province outlines without eez
pei <- sa_pei %>% 
  filter(PROVINCE %in% c("EEZ - Prince Edward Isla*", 
                          "Prince Edward Islands"))

#province outlines with eez
provinces_eez <- sa_pei %>% 
  filter(!PROVINCE %in% c("EEZ - Prince Edward Isla*", 
                          "Prince Edward Islands", 
                          "EEZ - mainland marine")) %>% 
  bind_rows(eez %>% 
              rename(geometry = geom))

#Lesotho and Eswatini
le_esw <- sa_pei %>% 
  filter(PROVINCE %in% c("Lesotho", "Eswatini"))

#PEI
pei <- sa_pei %>% 
  filter(PROVINCE %in% c("EEZ - Prince Edward Isla*", 
                          "Prince Edward Islands"))


#marine benthic ecosystem protection level
marine_benth <- marine %>%
  filter(ecosystem_functional_type_getl3 !="Pelagic ocean waters") %>% 
  ungroup() 

#marine pelagic ecosystem protection level
marine_pel <- marine %>%
  filter(ecosystem_functional_type_getl3 =="Pelagic ocean waters") %>% 
  ungroup() 



## map data to full indicator words
terr <- terr %>% 
mutate(RLE = str_replace_all(RLE, "CR","Critically Endangered" ))%>%
mutate(RLE = str_replace_all(RLE, "EN","Endangered" ))%>%
mutate(RLE = str_replace_all(RLE, "VU","Vulnerable" ))%>%
mutate(RLE = str_replace_all(RLE, "NT","Near Threatened" ))%>%
mutate(RLE = str_replace_all(RLE, "LC","Least Concern" ))%>%
  
mutate(epl_nat_inv24 = str_replace_all(epl_nat_inv24, "WP","Well Protected" ))%>%
mutate(epl_nat_inv24 = str_replace_all(epl_nat_inv24, "MP","Moderately Protected" ))%>%
mutate(epl_nat_inv24 = str_replace_all(epl_nat_inv24, "PP","Poorly Protected" ))%>%
mutate(epl_nat_inv24 = str_replace_all(epl_nat_inv24, "NP","Not Protected" )) %>% 
  rename(ecosystem_type = T_Name,
         geom = Shape,
         protection_level = epl_nat_inv24, 
         threat_status = RLE)%>% 
   filter(!ecosystem_type %in% c("Non-terrestrial (estuarine habitat)", 
                          "Non-terrestrial (Aquatic)"))


## estuaries as points
est_pnt <- est %>%
   rename(ecosystem_type = EcoType_na,
         geom = Shape,
         protection_level = PL_NBA18, 
         threat_status = RLE_NBA18)%>% 
mutate(protection_level = str_replace_all(protection_level, "Well","Well Protected" ))%>%
mutate(protection_level = str_replace_all(protection_level, "Moderately","Moderately Protected" ))%>%
mutate(protection_level = str_replace_all(protection_level, "Poorly","Poorly Protected" ))%>% 
#  st_cast("POLYGON") %>% #get each polygon
#  st_centroid() %>%   #make points
  # mutate(eco_extent_km2 = st_area(geom)) %>%
  # mutate(eco_extent_km2 = as.numeric(units::set_units(eco_extent_km2, km^2))) %>% 
  mutate(protection_level = factor(protection_level, levels = nbaR::NBA_categories))%>% #match category to it's colour
  mutate(threat_status = factor(threat_status, levels = nbaR::NBA_categories)) %>% #match category to it's colour
  filter(!is.na(protection_level)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(threat_status))


rivers <- freshwater %>%
  st_zm() %>% 
  rename(geom = Shape,
         protection_level = NBA2018EPL,
         threat_status = NBA2018ETS)%>% 
mutate(threat_status = str_replace_all(threat_status, "CR","Critically Endangered" ))%>%
mutate(threat_status = str_replace_all(threat_status, "EN","Endangered" ))%>%
mutate(threat_status = str_replace_all(threat_status, "VU","Vulnerable" ))%>%
mutate(threat_status = str_replace_all(threat_status, "NT","Near Threatened" ))%>%
mutate(threat_status = str_replace_all(threat_status, "LT","Least Concern" ))%>%
  
mutate(protection_level = str_replace_all(protection_level, "WP","Well Protected" ))%>%
mutate(protection_level = str_replace_all(protection_level, "MP","Moderately Protected" ))%>%
mutate(protection_level = str_replace_all(protection_level, "PP","Poorly Protected" ))%>%
mutate(protection_level = str_replace_all(protection_level, "NP","Not Protected" )) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(protection_level)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(threat_status))%>%
  st_make_valid() %>% 
 mutate(protection_level = str_trim(protection_level)) %>% # trim whitespace
 mutate(threat_status = str_trim(threat_status)) %>% # trim whitespace
  filter(threat_status != "")

##blank protection level and threat status is 7431 foreign, one 4_N_F, and one empty RIVTYPE. 

#summary(as.factor(rivers$RIVTYPE))

```



## Protection level plots


### terrestrial and benthic marine

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 28.34646
#| fig-height: 18.89764



#combine terrestrial and marine benthic ecosystem protection level
terr_marine_benth <- marine_benth %>% 
  bind_rows(terr)
  


##map EPL

pro_level <- nbaR::nba_map(terr_marine_benth,
                      geom,
                      FILL = protection_level)


pro_level+
  geom_sf(data=marine_benth, colour = "White", fill = NA) + #add ecosystem outlines for marine
  geom_sf(data=le_esw, colour = "white", fill = "white") + #make lesotho and eswatini white
  geom_sf(data=provinces_eez, colour = "black", fill = NA) #add province outlines
  


ggsave(here::here("outputs/EPL_terr_marine.png"), height = 48, width = 72, units = 'cm',  bg = "white", dpi = 350)


##map ETS

pro_level <- nbaR::nba_map(terr_marine_benth,
                      geom,
                      FILL = threat_status)


pro_level+
  geom_sf(data=marine_benth, colour = "White", fill = NA) + #add ecosystem outlines for marine
  geom_sf(data=le_esw, colour = "white", fill = "white") + #make lesotho and eswatini white
  geom_sf(data=provinces_eez, colour = "black", fill = NA) #add province outlines
  


ggsave(here::here("outputs/ETS_terr_marine.png"), height = 48, width = 72, units = 'cm',  bg = "white", dpi = 350)


```


### Estuarine and pelagic marine


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 28.34646
#| fig-height: 18.89764


##map EPL
pro_level_marine <- nbaR::nba_map(marine_pel,
                      geom,
                      FILL = protection_level)



pro_level_marine+
  geom_sf(data = st_jitter(est_pnt, factor = 0.002), aes(size = EST_KM2, colour = protection_level)) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = nbaR::NBA_colours) +
  ggplot2::scale_size(range = c(3, 30)) +
  geom_sf(data=marine_pel, colour = "white", fill = NA) + #add ecosystem outlines for marine
  geom_sf(data=le_esw, colour = "white", fill = "white") + #make lesotho and eswatini white
  geom_sf(data=provinces_eez, colour = "black", fill = NA) #add province outlines
  


ggsave(here::here("outputs/EPL_est_marine.png"), height = 48, width = 72, units = 'cm',  bg = "white", dpi = 350)

##map EPL
pro_level_marine <- nbaR::nba_map(marine_pel,
                      geom,
                      FILL = threat_status)



pro_level_marine+
  geom_sf(data = st_jitter(est_pnt, factor = 0.002), aes(size = EST_KM2, colour = threat_status)) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = nbaR::NBA_colours) +
  ggplot2::scale_size(range = c(3, 30)) +
  geom_sf(data=marine_pel, colour = "white", fill = NA) + #add ecosystem outlines for marine
  geom_sf(data=le_esw, colour = "white", fill = "white") + #make lesotho and eswatini white
  geom_sf(data=provinces_eez, colour = "black", fill = NA) #add province outlines
  


ggsave(here::here("outputs/ETS_est_marine.png"), height = 48, width = 72, units = 'cm',  bg = "white", dpi = 350)
```

### Rivers


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 28.34646
#| fig-height: 18.89764

##Rivers


# pro_level <- nbaR::nba_map(rivers,
#                       geom,
#                       FILL = protection_level)
# pro_level


##map EPL
pro_level <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = rivers, aes(fill = protection_level, colour = protection_level), lwd = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = nbaR::NBA_colours) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = nbaR::NBA_colours)+
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none",

                   axis.text = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_blank())

ggsave(here::here("outputs/ETS_rivers.png"), height = 48, width = 72, units = 'cm',  bg = "white", dpi = 350)
```

## condition map


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 28.34646
#| fig-height: 18.89764

##condition

# # Convert the raster to a factor type
# cnd_marine_benth_fact <- terra::as.factor(cnd_marine_benth)

##marine
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
colrs <- data.frame(id=1:4, condition =c("Natural", "Moderately modified", "Heavily / intensively modified", "Permanently / irreversibly modified"))


levels(cnd_marine_benth) <- colrs


## crop the raster to the eez
cnd_crop <- cnd_marine_benth %>% 
  terra::crop(terra::vect(eez),  mask = TRUE)

#----------------------------------------------------------------------------
## terrestrial

colrs_terr <- data.frame(id=1:4, condition =c("Permanently / irreversibly modified", "Heavily / intensively modified","Moderately modified", "Natural" ))

levels(cnd_terr) <- colrs_terr


## crop the raster to the eez
cnd_crop_terr <- cnd_terr %>% 
  terra::crop(terra::vect(sa_pei %>% 
  filter(!PROVINCE %in% c("EEZ - Prince Edward Isla*", 
                          "Prince Edward Islands", 
                          "EEZ - mainland marine"))),  mask = TRUE)


ggplot()+
  geom_spatraster(data=cnd_crop, )+
  scale_fill_manual(values = nbaR::NBA_colours, na.value = "transparent")+
  geom_spatraster(data=cnd_crop_terr, )+
  scale_fill_manual(values = nbaR::NBA_colours, na.value = "transparent")+
  geom_sf(data=le_esw, colour = "white", fill = "white") + #make lesotho and eswatini white
  geom_sf(data=provinces_eez, colour = "black", fill = NA)+ #add province outlines
  theme(legend.position = "none",
         plot.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
         panel.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
         panel.border = ggplot2::element_blank(),
         axis.text = ggplot2::element_blank(),
         axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_blank())


ggsave(here::here("outputs/cnd_terr_marine.png"), height = 48, width = 72, units = 'cm',  bg = "white", dpi = 350)



```
